parts.text: Some students are investigating how the volume of water affects the rate at which water in a beaker cools. They are using the apparatus shown in Fig. 2.1. Fig. 2.1

parts.text: (a) (i) 200 cm 3 of hot water is poured into beaker A and the initial temperature rises to the value shown on thermometer A in Fig. 2.1.
